verdicts.title: A Constructive Proof of Cut Elimination for a System of Full Second Order Logic
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we present a constructive proof of cut elimination for a system of full second order logic with the structural rules absorbed and using sets instead of sequences. The standard problem of the cutrank growth is avoided by using a new parameter for the induction, the cutweight. This technique can also be applied to first order logic.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns cut elimination in second-order logic using a 'cutweight' induction parameter, which shares no interaction with min-occurrence DP elimination on 3-regular Tseitin formulas. The 'cut elimination' vocabulary is from proof theory, not resolution proof complexity on Tseitin instances.

verdicts.title: Dp-minimality: basic facts and examples
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the notion of dp-minimality, beginning by providing several essential facts, establishing several equivalent definitions, and comparing dp-minimality to other minimality notions.
